description: Capacity, observed changes, selectable consumption trends and fill estimates, and collection health for non-Kubernetes node exporters (integrations/unix).

panels.title: Filesystem capacity · current and observed changes
panels.description: Available is usable by ordinary users. Allocated = size − free. Reserved = free − available. Net used changes compare allocated bytes with 24h/7d ago, not regression or projected growth. Missing historical endpoints stay blank. Inodes are omitted when the filesystem reports no inode capacity. Pseudo, memory, FUSE and network filesystems are excluded; this view focuses on durable local storage.

panels.title: Capacity outlook · $forecast_window trend
panels.description: Linear estimate from the selected Trend window, anchored at current available space. Consumption/day is positive when filling and negative when freeing space. Days are uncapped; Not filling means a flat or increasing availability trend. Zero means the threshold is already reached, even during recovery. Cleanup and differing short/long trends do not suppress results; compare 6h, 24h and 7d windows and inspect history. Regression uses the available history (at least two five-minute points); partial windows can be noisy. Estimates are withheld for stale samples (>=5m), reported read-only/collection errors, capacity changes or insufficient history. Absent optional health metrics do not suppress forecasts. These are trend scenarios, not confidence bounds or guarantees.
